mapper.insert: insert into chat_channel( chat_channel_no, project_no, chat_channel_creator, char_channel_name ) values ( #{chatChannelNo}, #{projectNo}, #{chatChannelCreator}, #{chateChannelName} )
mapper.select: select C.chat_channel_no, C.project_no, C.chat_channel_creator, C.chat_channel_name, C.chat_channel_ctime, C.chat_channel_utime, E.emp_name AS chat_channel_creator_name from chat_channel C left join project_member PM on C.chat_channel_creator = PM.project_member_no left join emp E on PM.emp_no = E.emp_no where C.project_no = #{projectNo} and C.chat_channel_no = #{chatChannelNo}
mapper.update: update chat_channel set chat_channel_name = #{chatChannelName}, chat_channel_utime = systimestamp where chat_channel_no = #{chatChannelNo}
